name: CD Player
description: Native PS5 homebrew audio CD player for compatible external USB optical drives, including Apple USB SuperDrive. Features MusicBrainz album identification, Cover Art Archive artwork, track metadata, 161 audio-reactive visualizers, a ten-band equalizer, gapless playback, volume control, optional stereo-to-7.1 upmix, saved preferences and software disc eject.
author: LoZazaMastro
